skins.name: Ingenious Servant
skins.description: A bespoke outfit ordered at the Savile Boutique Tailors by Kjera, the finished product of bewildering quality thanks to the fantastic minds of the designers, plus Kjera's own clever touch.

skins.name: Cardboard Fairy
skins.description: A smorgasbord of different elements and styles, featuring a red undergarment that contrasts with the green jacket. Kafka's fashion sense is as bold as her découpage.

skins.name: Gift Uncompleted
skins.description: An off-white knitted sweater paired with light-green silk pajamas for a low-key aesthetic. When in the company of friends, comfort is the highest priority.

skins.name: Hohenlohe Chillysand
skins.code: Carnelian's winter outfit in Leithanien /Hohenlohe Chillysand
skins.description: A traditional Leithanian women's trenchcoat with a pair of animal skin shawls and fleece gloves. Fear not the cold.

skins.name: Hope Cruise
skins.description: Made in Victorian fashion, featuring exquisite materials. Perfectly aligned while maintaining comfort to give an overall crisp look to the outfit – simple, yet not so simple.
